build_task_with_define_task_decorator: build a PHYRE task using the @creator_lib.define_task decorator to register a new task function
create_objects_with_C_add: create scene objects like static bars, dynamic jars, and dynamic balls using C.add with scale
position_objects_with_setters: position objects in the scene using set_left, set_bottom, set_center_x, and set_angle methods
define_task_goal_with_update_task: define the task goal by calling C.update_task with body1, body2, and spatial relationships
use_spatial_relationship_inside: use C.SpatialRelationship.INSIDE to specify that one body should end up inside another body
